command: pre-registration of the online binding read

arms.own: zero-shot pi0.5 on LIBERO-90 tasks 46-59 (living rooms 1-3: the same scenes with different named objects), each under its own instruction
arms.swap_object: LIBERO-Object (in-distribution layouts) tasks 0-4 under their instruction with the object replaced by each other candidate present in the layout (factors.substitute, scene phrasing)

decisions.object_words_not_read: swap BA <= 0.3 AND living-room BA <= 0.3 for named objects that are not the scene's habit -> zero-shot object composition is dead on pi0.5; the fold (factor tokens) is the main line
decisions.otherwise: composition pilots on practice states decide

metrics.episodes: 10 per arm and task, practice init states 0-9, light recordings with every object's pose
metrics.measure: binding accuracy BA: share of episodes whose first object displaced > 3 cm with the gripper command closed is the named object (experiments/f1_binding.py); also which object is bound otherwise (habit)
metrics.question: when the instruction names object X, which object does pi0.5 move? (does it READ object words, or does the scene key a trained habit?)
